purpose: Choose exactly one deterministic, no-fit Alpha158 trend-linearity mechanism for Campaign296 without reading Campaign296 candidate values, comparator values, daily prices or forward returns.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_linear_trend_quality_10d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: BETA10 is the ten-session close-price regression slope divided by current close, while RSQR10 is the corresponding coefficient of determination. Their product preserves the signed slope and attenuates it when the ten-session path is poorly described by one line. This is an own-stock trend-linearity mechanism with no volume confirmation, gain/loss balance, peer rank, cross-horizon geometry, event state or fitted return model.

parameters.rsquare_valid_interval: finite and inside [0,1] within 1e-6 numerical tolerance
parameters.beta_rule: finite with no clipping, winsorization, rank transform or bound

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_beta10
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: BETA10 alone is an existing raw Alpha158 coordinate and omits the selected linear-fit-quality hypothesis.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_rsqr10
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: RSQR10 alone is unsigned and would give the same preference to a smooth decline and a smooth advance; it is also an existing raw Alpha158 coordinate.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_linear_trend_quality_affine_or_power_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Using sqrt(RSQR10), RSQR10 squared, an affine floor, a threshold, sign agreement or a fitted exponent would create a postulated transform search. The direct product is frozen.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_linear_trend_quality_horizon_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Trying 5, 20, 30 or 60 sessions, averaging horizons or selecting the best horizon would create a horizon search. Ten sessions is frozen once before values because it is the shortest non-weekly Alpha158 regression horizon and remains distinct from Campaign295's 20-session price-volume mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_residual_or_slope_residual_interaction
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: RESI10 sign, magnitude, absolute value and its possible interaction with BETA10 or RSQR10 introduce a separate terminal-deviation hypothesis and multiple discretionary transforms.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign295_retune_reverse_rehorizon_threshold_reweight_or_combination
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign295 is terminal. Its SUMD20 and CORD20 formula may not be inverted, re-horizoned, thresholded, reweighted, combined or otherwise rescued. Campaign296 uses neither input.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_peer_rank_state_consensus_extremity_persistence_or_horizon_geometry_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign290--294 already consumed that mechanism cluster. Campaign296 uses raw within-stock regression coordinates and no peer or cross-horizon state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_supervised_tree_mlp_kernel_hash_or_weight_search
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign286--289 and later historical model campaigns already consumed fitted or randomized model families. Campaign296 contains exactly one deterministic weight-1 factor and no training return read.

selected_formula.name: alpha158_linear_trend_quality_10d
selected_formula.formula: For each quality/listing-eligible Alpha158 row with frozen model support, require finite BETA10 and RSQR10 and require RSQR10 inside [0,1] within 1e-6. Set score=BETA10*RSQR10. Do not fill, clip, winsorize, rank, sign, threshold, lag, fit, invert, subset, average across horizons or combine the score.
selected_formula.economic_hypothesis: A positive ten-session normalized price slope is more credible when a single linear trend explains more of the path, while a noisy slope should be attenuated. A smooth positive trend may persist from the next accepted open through the third accepted close; a smooth decline remains negative rather than being relabelled as favorable.

mechanism_separation.campaign295: No SUMD, CORD, volume, gain/loss balance or price-volume confirmation is used.
mechanism_separation.campaign290_to_campaign294: No session median, peer rank, state count, persistence, extremity, cross-horizon difference, dispersion or consensus is used.
mechanism_separation.campaign286_to_campaign289: No return-supervised fit, tree, neural network, random Fourier feature or hash cell is used.
mechanism_separation.minute_and_event_library: No minute bar, market peer, activity profile, quarterly value, disclosure timing or provider event field is used.
